Vessel CA1- VSL STBY near ORIENTAL PHOENIX anchorage; DP operation delayed due to DGPS signal loss. DGPS active Anchor heave up and proceeded to OPH@@10:40. Entered 500 m zone and positioned under port-side crane. 15:00-19:20, Cargo operations completed with 5 lifts offloaded to OPH and 3 lifts backloaded , Pullout, clear of OPH, exited the 500 m zone, and continued passage toward ORIENTAL DRAGON-1 @19:28

Vessel CA3- Vessel Arrived Shuaiba Port Berth 20, secured alongside at 04:54 hrs. Cargo operations carried out, including 1 truck of fuel oil received from shore and food provisions loaded@ 07:48-15:54, Cast off from Shuaiba Port and proceeded to OPH@ 16:12 hrs. Arrived at OPH location@1912 hrs , dropped standby anchor and remained anchored at OPH.
Vessel CA5- Vessel STBY at OD1 location

Vessel Charlie 3- Vessel STBY at Shuaiba Port Berth 4, cast off @12:40 hrs and proceeded to OPH. Entered 500 m zone @13:40 hrs and came alongside STBD side of rig @13:50 hrs. Received 7 PAX from rig @14:41-14:46 hrs, pulled out @14:47 hrs and exited 500 m zone @14:50 hrs. Proceeded to Jal Boot Village and maintained position off channel entrance awaiting taxi boat. Transferred 7 PAX to taxi boat @18:15 hrs, proceeded to Shuaiba Port @18:20 hrs and secured alongside B#4 @20:35 hrs. Vessel remained STBY alongside Shuaiba Port Berth 4.

Vessel CA1- VSL enroute from OPH to OD-1, arrived 500 m zone OD-1 @02:18 and standby. Proceeded to CA5 @12:20, came alongside in DP mode to collect modified flange, cast off @13:05 and returned to OD-1. Entered 500 m zone @13:40, one crew transferred to rig for flange modification discussion and rejoined vessel @15:00. Collected modified flange @18:25, departed OD-1 @18:30 and proceeded to Bunker Barge MT SEDRA-II. Secured alongside @20:08, bunker hose connected @20:45, commenced fuel receiving @21:12 (in progress).

Vessel CA1- Vessel STBY at OPH location,heave up anchor@16:04,VSL in position on the port side of OPH@19:00,transferred fresh water (120 M3), cargo operation completed, Pull out@22:00, Vessel STBY at OPH location.
